about_short_description.short_description: Mobile app, Payment solutions, Fintech, Digital financing

product.name: Flooss Islamic Financing
product.description: Digital Sharia-compliant cash financing for Bahrain residents, providing BHD 100–2,500 with repayment terms of 2–36 months and disbursement to an IBAN or STC Pay wallet.

product.name: Flooss Split
product.description: A buy now, pay later service that lets eligible customers make purchases at partner stores and repay them in four installments, with the first installment paid at purchase and zero profit.

product.name: Flooss Soouq
product.description: An in-app financing marketplace for purchasing electronic devices from partner merchants and repaying the purchase through monthly installments.

product.name: Flooss Wallet
product.description: A mobile wallet for making in-app payments, paying bills, topping up the wallet, and transferring money to other Flooss Wallet users.

identifier.value: Flooss Bill Payments and Mobile Top-Ups

product.name: Flooss Bill Payments and Mobile Top-Ups
product.description: In-app payment services for telecom, electricity and water bills, mobile top-ups, and saved recurring bills.

product.name: Flooss Gift Cards and Vouchers
product.description: Digital purchase of prepaid vouchers and gift cards, including cards for Apple, Google Play, PlayStation, and other supported brands.
